title: Mount Manaia Track: Whangārei Heads area, Northland region
overview: A steep climb through regenerating native bush to the summit of Mount Manaia rewards you with breath-taking views of the dramatic entrance to Whangārei-Terenga-Paraoa (Whangārei Harbour).
One of the most dramatic harbour entrances in Aotearoa New Zealand.
Spectacular view from the Bluff lookout to Te Whara/Bream Head, Taranga and the Marotere islands (Hen and Chicken islands).
Gradient: Steep climb with many steps
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.
lines: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
Department of Conservation | Te Papa Atawhai
Mount Manaia is 28 km east of Whangārei. Park in the Mount Manaia Club's lower car park on Whangārei Heads Road above McLeod Bay. The track begins just above the car park.
